verses.original: לֵ֣ץ הַ֭יַּין הֹמֶ֣ה שֵׁכָ֑ר וְכָל־ שֹׁ֥גֶה בּ֝֗וֹ לֹ֣א יֶחְכָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lêṣ hay·yayn hō·meh šê·ḵār wə·ḵāl šō·ḡeh bōw lō yeḥ·kām
verses.literal: Wine is a mocker strong drink is a brawler and whoever is led astray by them is not wise
verses.literalPt: O vinho é escarnecedor, e a bebida forte, turbulenta; e todo aquele que é vencido por eles não é sábio.

verses.original: נַ֣הַם כַּ֭כְּפִיר אֵ֣ימַת מֶ֑לֶךְ מִ֝תְעַבְּר֗וֹ חוֹטֵ֥א נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: na·ham kak·kə·p̄îr ’ê·maṯ me·leḵ miṯ·‘ab·bə·rōw ḥō·w·ṭê nap̄·šōw
verses.literal: The terror of a king is like the roar of a lion whoever provokes him forfeits his own life
verses.literalPt: Como o bramido do leão, é o terror do rei; quem o irrita peca contra a sua vida.

verses.original: כָּב֣וֹד לָ֭אִישׁ שֶׁ֣בֶת מֵרִ֑יב וְכָל־ אֱ֝וִ֗יל יִתְגַּלָּֽע׃
verses.transliteration: kā·ḇō·wḏ lā·’îš še·ḇeṯ mê·rîḇ wə·ḵāl ’ĕ·wîl yiṯ·gal·lā‘
verses.literal: It is honorable for a man to resolve a dispute but any fool will quarrel
verses.literalPt: O abster-se de contendas é honra para o homem, mas todo insensato mete-se em rixas.

verses.original: מֵ֭חֹרֶף עָצֵ֣ל לֹא־ יַחֲרֹ֑שׁ יִשְׁאַל בַּקָּצִ֣יר וָאָֽיִן׃
verses.transliteration: mê·ḥō·rep̄ ‘ā·ṣêl lō- ya·ḥă·rōš yiš·ʾal baq·qā·ṣîr wā·’ā·yin
verses.literal: The slacker does not plow in season at harvest time he looks but nothing is there
verses.literalPt: O preguiçoso não lavra por causa do inverno; por isso, na ceifa procura e nada tem.

verses.original: מַ֣יִם עֲ֭מֻקִּים עֵצָ֣ה בְלֶב־ אִ֑ישׁ וְאִ֖ישׁ תְּבוּנָ֣ה יִדְלֶֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: ma·yim ‘ă·muq·qîm ‘ê·ṣāh ḇə·leḇ- ’îš wə·’îš tə·ḇū·nāh yiḏ·len·nāh
verses.literal: The intentions of a man’s heart are deep waters but a man of understanding draws them out
verses.literalPt: Como águas profundas, é o conselho no coração do homem, mas o homem inteligente o tirará para fora.

verses.original: רָב־ אָדָ֗ם יִ֭קְרָא אִ֣ישׁ חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְאִ֥ישׁ אֱ֝מוּנִ֗ים מִ֣י יִמְצָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: rāḇ- ’ā·ḏām yiq·rā ’îš ḥas·dōw wə·’îš ’ĕ·mū·nîm mî yim·ṣā
verses.literal: Many a man proclaims his loving devotion but who can find a trustworthy man
verses.literalPt: Muitos proclamam a sua benignidade, mas o homem fidedigno, quem o poderá achar?

verses.original: מִתְהַלֵּ֣ךְ בְּתֻמּ֣וֹ צַדִּ֑יק אַשְׁרֵ֖י בָנָ֣יו אַחֲרָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: miṯ·hal·lêḵ bə·ṯum·mōw ṣad·dîq ’aš·rê ḇā·nāw ’a·ḥă·rāw
verses.literal: The righteous man walks with integrity blessed are his children after him
verses.literalPt: O justo anda na sua integridade; felizes são seus filhos depois dele.

verses.original: מֶ֗לֶךְ יוֹשֵׁ֥ב עַל־ כִּסֵּא־ דִ֑ין מְזָרֶ֖ה בְעֵינָ֣יו כָּל־ רָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: me·leḵ yō·wō·šêḇ ‘al- kis·sê- ḏîn mə·zā·reh ḇə·‘ê·nāw kāl- rā‘
verses.literal: A king who sits on a throne to judge sifts out all evil with his eyes
verses.literalPt: O rei que está sentado no trono do juízo dissipa todo mal com os seus olhos.

verses.original: מִֽי־ יֹ֭אמַר זִכִּ֣יתִי לִבִּ֑י טָ֝הַ֗רְתִּי מֵחַטָּאתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: mî- yō·mar zik·kî·ṯî lib·bî ṭā·har·tî mê·ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯî
verses.literal: Who can say I have kept my heart pure I am cleansed from my sin
verses.literalPt: Quem pode dizer: Purifiquei o meu coração, limpo estou do meu pecado?

verses.original: אֶ֣בֶן וָ֭אֶבֶן אֵיפָ֣ה וְאֵיפָ֑ה תּוֹעֲבַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה גַּם־ שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’e·ḇen wā·’e·ḇen ’ê·p̄āh wə·’ê·p̄āh tō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ Yah·weh gam- šə·nê·hem
verses.literal: Differing weights and unequal measures . . . both are detestable to the LORD . . .
verses.literalPt: Pesos diversos e medidas diversas, ambos são igualmente abominação a Jeová.

verses.original: גַּ֣ם בְּ֭מַעֲלָלָיו יִתְנַכֶּר־ נָ֑עַר אִם־ זַ֖ךְ וְאִם־ יָשָׁ֣ר פָּעֳלֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: gam bə·ma·‘ă·lā·lāw yiṯ·nak·ker- nā·‘ar ’im- zaḵ wə·’im- yā·šār pā·‘o·lōw
verses.literal: Even a young man is known by his actions whether his conduct is pure . . . and upright
verses.literalPt: Até a criança dá-se a conhecer pelos seus atos, se a sua conduta é pura, se é reta.

verses.original: אֹ֣זֶן שֹׁ֭מַעַת וְעַ֣יִן רֹאָ֑ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה עָשָׂ֥ה גַם־ שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·zen šō·mēr wə·‘a·yin rō·’āh Yah·weh ‘ā·śāh ḡam- šə·nê·hem
verses.literal: Ears that hear and eyes that see the LORD has made them . . . both
verses.literalPt: O ouvido que ouve e o olho que vê, é Jeová que fez tanto um como outro.

verses.original: אַל־ תֶּֽאֱהַ֣ב שֵׁ֭נָה פֶּן־ תִּוָּרֵ֑שׁ פְּקַ֖ח עֵינֶ֣יךָ שְֽׂבַֽע־ לָֽחֶם׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- te·’ĕ·haḇ šē·nāh pen- tiw·wā·rêš pə·qaḥ ‘ê·ne·ḵā śə·ḇa‘- lā·ḥem
verses.literal: Do not love sleep or you will grow poor open your eyes and you will have plenty of food
verses.literalPt: Não ames o sono, para que não empobreças; abre os teus olhos, e te fartarás de pão.

verses.original: רַ֣ע רַ֭ע יֹאמַ֣ר הַקּוֹנֶ֑ה וְאֹזֵ֥ל ל֝֗וֹ אָ֣ז יִתְהַלָּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ra‘ ra‘ yō·mar haq·qō·w·neh wə·’ō·zêl lōw ’āz yiṯ·hal·lāl
verses.literal: Worthless worthless says the buyer but on the way out he gloats
verses.literalPt: Ruim, ruim, diz o comprador; mas, depois de se retirar, felicita-se.

verses.original: יֵ֣שׁ זָ֭הָב וְרָב־ פְּנִינִ֑ים וּכְלִ֥י יְ֝קָ֗ר שִׂפְתֵי־ דָֽעַת׃
verses.transliteration: yêš zā·hāḇ wə·rāḇ- pə·nî·nîm ū·ḵə·lî yə·qār śip̄·ṯê- ḏā·‘aṯ
verses.literal: There is an abundance of gold and rubies but lips of knowledge are a rare treasure
verses.literalPt: Há ouro e abundância de corais, mas, os lábios sábios são joia preciosa.

verses.original: לְֽקַח־ בִּ֭גְדוֹ כִּי־ עָ֣רַב זָ֑ר וּבְעַ֖ד נָכְרִים חַבְלֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·qaḥ- biḡ·ḏōw kî- ‘ā·raḇ zār ū·ḇə·‘aḏ nå̄·ḵə·rīm ḥaḇ·lê·hū
verses.literal: Take the garment of the one who posts security for a stranger get collateral if it is for a foreigner
verses.literalPt: Deve-se tirar o vestido àquele que fica fiador por outro e tomar como penhor quem se obriga por estrangeiros.

verses.original: עָרֵ֣ב לָ֭אִישׁ לֶ֣חֶם שָׁ֑קֶר וְ֝אַחַ֗ר יִמָּֽלֵא־ פִ֥יהוּ חָצָֽץ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·rêḇ lā·’îš le·ḥem šā·qer wə·’a·ḥar yim·mā·lê- p̄î·hū ḥā·ṣāṣ
verses.literal: Food gained by fraud is sweet to a man but later his mouth is full of gravel
verses.literalPt: Suave é ao homem o pão de mentira, mas, depois, a sua boca se encherá de cascalho.

verses.original: מַ֭חֲשָׁבוֹת בְּעֵצָ֣ה תִכּ֑וֹן וּ֝בְתַחְבֻּל֗וֹת עֲשֵׂ֣ה מִלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ma·ḥă·šā·ḇō·wṯ bə·‘ê·ṣāh ṯik·kō·wn ū·ḇə·ṯaḥ·bu·lō·wṯ ‘ă·śêh mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: Set plans by consultation and wage war under sound guidance
verses.literalPt: Os projetos confirmam-se pelos conselhos; faze a guerra com prudência.

verses.original: גּֽוֹלֶה־ סּ֭וֹד הוֹלֵ֣ךְ רָכִ֑יל וּלְפֹתֶ֥ה שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִתְעָרָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: gō·w·leh- sō·wḏ hō·w·lêḵ rā·ḵîl ū·lə·p̄ō·ṯeh śə·p̲ā·t̲āyw lō ṯiṯ·‘ā·rāḇ
verses.literal: He who reveals secrets is a constant gossip avoid the one who babbles with his lips
verses.literalPt: O mexeriqueiro revela os segredos. Portanto, não te metas com quem muito abre os seus lábios.

verses.original: מְ֭קַלֵּל אָבִ֣יו וְאִמּ֑וֹ יִֽדְעַ֥ךְ נֵ֝ר֗וֹ בְּאִישׁוֹן חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.transliteration: mə·qal·lêl ’ā·ḇîw wə·’im·mōw yiḏ·‘aḵ nê·rōw bə·ʾī·šōn ḥō·šeḵ
verses.literal: Whoever curses his father or mother his lamp will be extinguished in deepest darkness
verses.literalPt: Quem amaldiçoa a seu pai ou a sua mãe, apagar-se-lhe-á a lâmpada nas mais densas trevas.

verses.original: נַ֭חֲלָה מְבֻחֶלֶת בָּרִאשֹׁנָ֑ה וְ֝אַחֲרִיתָ֗הּ לֹ֣א תְבֹרָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: na·ḥă·lāh mə·ḇu·ḥɛ·lɛṯ bā·ri·šō·nāh wə·’a·ḥă·rî·ṯāh lō ṯə·ḇō·rāḵ
verses.literal: An inheritance gained quickly will not be blessed in the end
verses.literalPt: A herança adquirida a princípio apressadamente, no fim, não será abençoada.

verses.original: אַל־ תֹּאמַ֥ר אֲשַׁלְּמָה־ רָ֑ע קַוֵּ֥ה לַֽ֝יהוָ֗ה וְיֹ֣שַֽׁע לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tō·mar ’ă·šal·lə·māh- rā‘ qaw·wêh Yah·weh wə·yō·ša‘ lāḵ
verses.literal: Do not say I will avenge this evil Wait on the LORD and He will save you
verses.literalPt: Não digas: Vingar-me-ei do mal; espera por Jeová, e ele te salvará.

verses.original: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה אֶ֣בֶן וָאָ֑בֶן וּמֹאזְנֵ֖י מִרְמָ֣ה לֹא־ טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: tō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ Yah·weh ’e·ḇen wā·’ā·ḇen ū·mō·zə·nê mir·māh lō- ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: Unequal weights . . . are detestable to the LORD and dishonest scales are no good
verses.literalPt: Pesos diversos são abominação a Jeová, e a balança falsa não é boa.

verses.original: מֵיהוָ֥ה מִצְעֲדֵי־ גָ֑בֶר וְ֝אָדָ֗ם מַה־ יָּבִ֥ין דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mē·h·wå̄h miṣ·‘ă·ḏê- ḡā·ḇer wə·’ā·ḏām mah- yā·ḇîn dar·kōw
verses.literal: A man’s steps are from the LORD so how can anyone understand his own way
verses.literalPt: Os passos do homem são dirigidos por Jeová; como, pois, poderá o homem entender o seu caminho?

verses.original: מוֹקֵ֣שׁ אָ֭דָם יָ֣לַע קֹ֑דֶשׁ וְאַחַ֖ר נְדָרִ֣ים לְבַקֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: mō·w·qêš ’ā·ḏām yā·la‘ qō·ḏeš wə·’a·ḥar nə·ḏā·rîm lə·ḇaq·qêr
verses.literal: It is a trap for a man to dedicate something rashly only later to reconsider his vows
verses.literalPt: Laço é para o homem o dizer temerariamente: É santo, e não refletir senão depois de fazer o voto.

verses.original: מְזָרֶ֣ה רְ֭שָׁעִים מֶ֣לֶךְ חָכָ֑ם וַיָּ֖שֶׁב עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם אוֹפָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: mə·zā·reh rə·šā·‘îm me·leḵ ḥā·ḵām way·yā·šeḇ ‘ă·lê·hem ’ō·w·p̄ān
verses.literal: A wise king separates out the wicked and drives the threshing wheel over them
verses.literalPt: O rei sábio joeira os perversos e faz passar a roda sobre eles.

verses.original: נֵ֣ר יְ֭הוָה נִשְׁמַ֣ת אָדָ֑ם חֹ֝פֵ֗שׂ כָּל־ חַדְרֵי־ בָֽטֶן׃
verses.transliteration: nêr Yah·weh niš·maṯ ’ā·ḏām ḥō·p̄êś kāl- ḥaḏ·rê- ḇā·ṭen
verses.literal: The spirit of a man is the lamp of the LORD searching out . . . his inmost being . . .
verses.literalPt: O espírito do homem é a lâmpada de Jeová, a qual esquadrinha todas as câmaras secretas da alma.

verses.original: חֶ֣סֶד וֶ֭אֱמֶת יִצְּרוּ־ מֶ֑לֶךְ וְסָעַ֖ד בַּחֶ֣סֶד כִּסְאֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥe·seḏ we·’ĕ·meṯ yiṣ·ṣə·rū- me·leḵ wə·sā·‘aḏ ba·ḥe·seḏ kis·’ōw
verses.literal: Loving devotion and faithfulness preserve a king by these he maintains his throne
verses.literalPt: A benignidade e a verdade preservam o rei, e o seu trono firma-se com a benignidade.

verses.original: תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת בַּחוּרִ֣ים כֹּחָ֑ם וַהֲדַ֖ר זְקֵנִ֣ים שֵׂיבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: tip̄·’e·reṯ ba·ḥū·rîm kō·ḥām wa·hă·ḏar zə·qê·nîm śê·ḇāh
verses.literal: The glory of young men is their strength and gray hair is the splendor of the old
verses.literalPt: A glória dos mancebos é a sua força, e a beleza dos velhos são as suas cãs.

verses.original: חַבֻּר֣וֹת פֶּ֭צַע תַּמְרִיק בְּרָ֑ע וּ֝מַכּ֗וֹת חַדְרֵי־ בָֽטֶן׃
verses.transliteration: ḥab·bu·rō·wṯ pe·ṣa‘ tam·rīq bə·rā‘ ū·mak·kō·wṯ ḥaḏ·rê- ḇā·ṭen
verses.literal: Lashes and wounds scour evil and beatings cleanse the inmost parts . . .
verses.literalPt: Os açoites que ferem purificam o mal, e as feridas alcançam o mais íntimo do corpo.
